actual_scope: Check the finite q-Toeplitz factorization G = L D_f L^T and its inverse formula for rational q at most 1/4.
scope_change_reason: The Neumann tail, the production-domain gap, and the compression-error sum are different questions. This package checks the q-Toeplitz factorization. It does not run the Gaussian core.
bottleneck_link: Every checked factorization reproduces the Gaussian matrix and its inverse, and the selected kappa is unchanged.
stop_rule: Record this factorization. Do not run the Gaussian core or the chirp consumer.
evidence: All 30 matrices with q in {1/4,1/5,1/6,1/8,1/10} and order 1 through 6 satisfy T(g)T(h)=I and the five-factor inverse. At q=1/4 the product bound is 14/15 and the row-sum bound is 10/7.
